title: (RHBA-2022:4933) Fuse 7.10.2.P1 images
portal_summary: Red Hat Fuse 7.10.2.P1 release of 'Fuse on EAP' images.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|4.10|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|4.9|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, ensure you have applied all previously released errata relevant to your system.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The Fuse on EAP container images have been updated to address the following CVEs:

CVE-2021-22573

Users of Fuse on EAP container images are advised to upgrade to these updated images, which contain backported patches to correct these security issues, fix these bugs, and add these enhancements. Users of these images are also encouraged to rebuild all container images that depend on these images.

You can find images updated by this advisory in Red Hat Container Catalog (see
References).
